items.headline: According to Chinese media reports, several major smartphone makers have set lower shipment targets for 2027.
items.plain: Chinese smartphone makers cut 2027 shipment targets, lowering expected sales.
items.why: It may reduce demand for Indian phone distributors, but no direct listed-company impact.
items.original: - Xiaomi is targeting about 90 million units in 2027, down 25% from its 2026 target of about 120 million. - Lenovo (primarily Motorola) is targeting about 40 million units in 2027, down 20% from about 50 million in 2026. - Apple is targeting about 220 million units in 2027, down 5.6% from about 233
